name: Daily Crypto Brief
tagline: An AI-written market brief, published every morning.
description: Scrapes signal-heavy Telegram channels overnight, extracts the trading signals worth keeping, and writes them up as a single readable brief. Runs itself on a schedule and publishes to a static site.

name: SEC Crypto Task Force Tracker
tagline: Every Crypto Task Force move, summarised and dated.
description: Watches four SEC Crypto Task Force pages for changes, diffs them, and writes a plain-English summary of what actually moved — meetings, statements, roundtables and personnel. Running continuously since January 2026.

name: Enforcement Radar
tagline: Digital-asset enforcement activity, in one view.
description: Pulls enforcement actions across regulators into a single filterable timeline, so the pattern of what is actually being pursued is visible at a glance rather than buried across press-release pages.

name: NTB Charter Tracker
tagline: Every U.S. national trust bank charter application before the OCC.
description: A survey of the current state of play on national trust bank charter applications — approved, conditional, pending and denied — with proposed activities, timelines, OCC receipt dates, conditions, and comment-letter opposition, each cited to its source.
